objective: Run trusted validation commands and preserve observed proof with no structured edit/write tools.

steps.task: Run these trusted validation commands from the repository root: `git status -sb` and `git diff --check`. Report pass/fail/deferred per command with cwd, important output, and failure bucket. Do not edit, install, publish, deploy, delete, or run network commands.
Summarize observed command results, deferred commands, failure buckets, and residual risk. Use only observed validation-proof output when summarizing command results.
